'''Giant Red thranta''' was a rare species of [[Thranta/Legends|thranta]], native to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the species was nearly extinct.<ref name="gsi" />

Exploiting their endangered status, [[Galactic Solutions Industries|Galactic Solution Industries]] was planting surveillance equipment on them, gathering intelligence data while hoping neither of the warring Alderaan factions would try to capture or kill a rare specimen. GSI contractors were tasked with monitoring the thrantas, to manually recover the gathered data via [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinocular]] scanners.<ref name="gsi" />
